question: Does combining a lexical Random Forest with a URL character-pattern classifier improve phishing F1 and false-positive rate relative to the lexical baseline?
outer_split: Reuse the stored domain-disjoint train/test partition. This historical test set has been inspected in earlier work; this extension is exploratory, not a fresh confirmatory test.
inner_split: First seed-73 StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5) fold within the outer training partition only.

character_model.input: canonical_url from the shared offline parser

selection_rule: Choose maximum inner-validation phishing F1; ties choose the smaller character weight. Fix the weight before evaluating the historical test set.
uncertainty: 500 paired registrable-domain cluster bootstrap draws for hybrid minus lexical test F1; percentile interval is exploratory and conditional on fitted models.
prohibitions: No test-set hyperparameter or threshold selection
No changes to the deployed scanner models
No claim that this is a deep-learning or LLM experiment
